_fixture: FIXTURE, not a measurement. Produced by src.tools.data_curve.assemble.build_curve itself over synthetic cells (metrics JSONs plus their prediction bundles), so the plot tests exercise the real document schema. Recipe: van sits exactly on its anchors_tier_S.json mean at every fraction; cyl beats it by BENEFIT = {25%: 0.9, 50%: 0.7, 75%: 0.6} on T60, 2x that on EDT, +0.1 on C50 (worse, as at 100 %) and +BENEFIT on the recalls; each seed carries a small fixed jitter; the checkpoint digest is the real sha256 of the fixture checkpoint bytes b'fixture'; bundles are 2-item stand-ins for the 6,337-item split; anchors are the MARGINAL form. No number here came from a trained model.
anchor_form_reason: no raw per-seed anchor cells were supplied for both arms (plan D10)

K1.line: C50 deficit holds from 100 % to 25 % of the data (B_100 = -0.1000, B_25 = -0.1000; negative = CylDINO worse). Descriptive only: C50 never enters the primary verdict.

K8.line: C50 deficit holds from 100 % to 25 % of the data (B_100 = -0.1000, B_25 = -0.1000; negative = CylDINO worse). Descriptive only: C50 never enters the primary verdict.

disclosures: Fixed-compute estimand -- a fixed-compute efficiency curve under jointly reduced target and context diversity: every run is 40,000 optimizer steps x a global batch of 64 = 2,560,000 target draws, so the 25 % arm revisits each RIR ~4x more often than the 100 % arm (effective epochs per fraction are tabulated below). This is NOT a fixed-epoch learning curve.

Aggregation is the pinned evaluator's AR convention: one item-weighted value over the whole 6,337-item unseen split per eval seed, then mean +- sd over seeds 42-46. No per-scene averaging anywhere in this experiment.
One training seed per cell: sd(d_s) is EVAL-seed noise, not training-run uncertainty (exp_12 Amendment 2), so the verdict is descriptive. The known step-to-step band on this stack is ~ +-0.5 T60.
Nested subsets with jointly reduced target AND context diversity; both arms are scored under their own conditioning protocol with all four flags explicit (announcement 05).
Frame-average chunking is N/A on this pin (announcement 06): the cyl arm trains and scores with frame_avg_angles = [0], orbit size 1.

The 100 % point is reported in the MARGINAL form (`anchor_form: marginal`; mean +- sd per arm, B_100 = difference of means, no paired sd), because no raw per-seed anchor cells were supplied for both arms (plan D10). The verdict rule uses B only, so it still evaluates.

verdict.rule: 3 (all positive and non-increasing in the data fraction)
